stem.text: Which statement correctly describes an event in the process of mass flow in phloem sieve tube elements?

A.text: Any part of a plant where sucrose is loaded into a sieve tube element is called a sink.

B.text: Loading sucrose into a sieve tube element increases the water potential inside it.

C.text: Mass flow in the phloem is a passive process occurring at the same rate as diffusion.

D.text: Sucrose moves down a hydrostatic pressure gradient in the phloem from source to sink.
